title: Cheesy Canadian Macaroni Casserole
description: A comforting and creamy macaroni casserole dish that combines the flavors of Canada.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar cheese until melted.
Stir in yellow mustard and gooey cheese sauce.
Combine cooked macaroni and cheese sauce in a large mixing bowl.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
